summary: The timed host loop invokes an OpenMP region whose outlined worker 0x22d0 receives the requested repetition count and per-thread row bounds. Each repetition traverses the assigned rows and all nonzeros in each CSR interval, accumulating val[j]*vec[cols[j]] and storing every row output, including explicit zero for empty rows. Source rowSplitPoint cuts span 0 through dim without row gaps.

source_evidence.claim: OpenMP build and optimized native compile flags.
CSR initialization, complete monotone row-split endpoints, runtime nItems/iterations, and persistent timed OpenMP repetition/call control.

compiled_evidence.claim: The clocked GOMP_parallel at 0x1c03 targets main._omp_fn.1 (0x22d0). Worker loads row bounds and count, loops repetitions with compare/backedge at 0x243f/0x2442 to 0x23e0, loops rows and row nonzeros, performs indexed multiply/add and stores output; empty rows are set to zero.
